Welcome to Turn Up Music

Before you start, please enter your date of birth.

Community Guidelines

  • Be kind. No harassment, hate speech, threats or bullying.
  • No sexual content, and nothing involving anyone under 18.
  • No spam, scams or pretending to be someone else.
  • People you meet here are strangers. Don't share your address, passwords or money details.
  • You can mute, block and report anyone, any time.

👤 Your account

Keep your progress safe and pick it up on any device.

🎵 Music mode

Parties, voice chat, the social feed, live events and memberships are for adults 18 and older, so they're turned off on this device.

You can still listen to all the radio stations and podcasts, play your own music, and explore every 3D world on your own.

Before you join the party

You're about to join a live party with real people. Everyone here should be 18 or older, but people you meet online are strangers.

  • 🎤 Your mic is off until you turn it on. Anyone nearby can hear you when it's on.
  • 🔇 Tap a guest (or touch them in VR) to mute, block or report them.
  • 🚪 You can leave any time with Leave the party.
  • 🔒 Never share your address, passwords, sign-in codes or money details.
  • 🆘 If someone is in danger, call 911 (or your local emergency number).

🚩 Report

Reports go to the Turn Up Music moderators. The person isn't told who reported them.

If anyone is in danger, call 911. To report a child being exploited, use the NCMEC CyberTipline at report.cybertip.org.

🛡 Safety center

My safety settings

Blocked people

Staying safe

  • Turn Up Music is for adults 18 and older. If you think someone is under 18, report them with “This person may be under 18”.
  • To mute, block or report someone, tap their name or avatar (in VR, touch them), or use 🚩 on a post.
  • Don't share personal details, sign-in codes or payment info with people you meet here. Turn Up Music staff will never ask for your codes.
  • Feel uncomfortable? Leave the party, change worlds, or turn your mic off. It's always okay to go.
  • If someone is in danger, call 911. For child safety concerns, use the NCMEC CyberTipline at report.cybertip.org.

Reports (moderators)

★ Turn Up memberships

Memberships are for adults 18+. Pay with the button on a plan; your membership turns on once it's confirmed (usually within a day). Cancel any time from the receipt email.

🎧 DJ boothSpin your own music and stations for the whole party, with two decks, a crossfader and effects.
📅 Host eventsPut your shows on the Live Events calendar and run them as the DJ.
🛋 VIP sectionsGet into the roped-off VIP area in every world.
📺 Watch togetherPlay a YouTube video or your own videos on the big screen for everyone.
✨ VIP badgeA gold VIP tag over your avatar and on your posts.
🛡 ModeratorsTrusted VIPs can be made moderators to mute or remove troublemakers.
